en-GB.author: ASSA ABLOY AB
en-GB.description: Software that handles the communication between the CLIQ Local Programming Device and CLIQ Web Manager or CLIQ Go.
en-GB.longDescription:
CLIQ Connect PC app is a software that handles the communication between the Local Programming Device and CLIQ Web Manager or CLIQ Go software. It is used when updating keys.
For CLIQ Go systems CLIQ Connect PC app is not required when logging in. However it is being used when updating keys. Only the right hand port of the Local Programming Device is used when updating keys in CLIQ Go systems.
For CLIQ Web Manager systems CLIQ Connect PC app is required when logging in and when updating keys. A C-key must be inserted in the left hand port of the Local Programming Device when logging in to CLIQ Web Manager while the right hand port is used when updating user keys or programming other C-keys.
The CLIQ Connect PC app can be used instead of, or in conjunction with, the CLIQ Connect mobile app when updating keys.
en-GB.name: CLIQ Connect

zh-CN.description: 用于处理 CLIQ 本地编程设备与 CLIQ Web Manager 或 CLIQ Go 之间通讯的软件。
zh-CN.longDescription:
CLIQ Connect PC 版用于处理本地编程设备（Local Programming Device）与 CLIQ Web Manager 或 CLIQ Go 软件之间的通讯，在更新钥匙时使用。
在 CLIQ Go 系统中，登录时不需要 CLIQ Connect PC 版，但更新钥匙时仍需使用。在 CLIQ Go 系统中更新钥匙时，仅使用本地编程设备的右侧接口。
在 CLIQ Web Manager 系统中，登录和更新钥匙时都需要 CLIQ Connect PC 版。登录 CLIQ Web Manager 时，必须将 C-key 插入本地编程设备的左侧接口；更新用户钥匙或编程其他 C-key 时使用右侧接口。
在更新钥匙时，可以使用 CLIQ Connect PC 版代替 CLIQ Connect 手机版，也可以两者配合使用。
